note: CHAT-AB-01: 22 single-turn items (2 runs per arm) and 2 nine-turn scripts (1 run per arm). `expectedAll` is a list of needles that must all appear (word-boundary, case-insensitive); each needle may be written as `a|b` for alternatives. Only the `reasoning` items and the multi-turn facts are machine-checked; every other reply is read by a person.

items.prompt: How does a heat pump work, and why can it deliver more heat than the electricity it uses?
Compare the French Revolution and the American Revolution: what caused each, and how did they end up so different?
Explain how a vaccine trains the immune system, and why some vaccines need booster shots.
Why do we have seasons? I always hear it is about distance from the sun, and I think that is wrong.
What causes inflation, and why do central banks raise interest rates to fight it?
How do noise-cancelling headphones actually work, and why are they better at humming engines than at voices?
A train leaves at 9:15 am and travels 210 km at 70 km/h. It then stops for 25 minutes, and finally travels another 90 km at 60 km/h. What time does it arrive?
Oliver buys 3 notebooks at $4.50 each and 2 pens at $1.25 each. He pays with a $20 bill and wants his change entirely in quarters. How many quarters does he get back?
Juniper is twice as old as her brother was when she was as old as he is now. Their ages add up to 42. How old is each of them now?
A tank fills in 6 hours with pipe A alone and in 9 hours with pipe B alone. A drain empties a full tank in 18 hours. With A, B and the drain all open, how long does it take to fill an empty tank?
expectedAll: 4.5|4 1/2|4½|four and a half|4 hours and 30|4 hours 30|4 hours, 30
